mapper.select: select id,creator_id,revision,current_version,type,approval_status from documents where id=#{documentId} and deleted='0'
select count(1) from purchase_orders p join documents d on d.id=p.document_id where p.supplier_id=#{documentId} and d.deleted='0' and d.approval_status<>'VOID'
select count(1) from receipts where order_id=#{documentId}
select count(1) from invoices i join documents d on d.id=i.document_id where i.order_id=#{documentId} and d.deleted='0' and d.approval_status<>'VOID'
mapper.update: update workflow_tasks t join workflow_instances i on i.id=t.instance_id set t.status='CANCELLED',t.revision=t.revision+1 where i.document_id=#{documentId} and t.status='PENDING'
update invoice_allocations set state='RELEASED' where invoice_id=#{documentId} and state in('RESERVED','CONFIRMED')
update documents set approval_status=#{status},current_node=null,revision=revision+1,update_time=now() where id=#{documentId} and revision=#{revision} and deleted='0'
update documents set deleted='1',revision=revision+1,update_time=now() where id=#{documentId} and revision=#{revision} and approval_status='DRAFT' and current_version=0 and deleted='0'
update workflow_instances set status=#{status},finished_at=now() where document_id=#{documentId} and status='RUNNING'
